posts.text: Yeah, don’t give Meta’s Muse app access to your Mac. The ability of AI systems to act as agents, carrying out tasks on our behalf, is the single biggest development in the technology. This is the headline capability Siri AI introduces to Apple devices, and I’m inclined to trust the privacy and safety safeguards Apple has put into place. But Siri AI isn’t the only agent you can give full access to your Apple devices, with Meta’s Muse app the latest example – and one tech writer’s experience really underlines why you absolutely don’t want to do this … more…

posts.author: Bloomberg Tech
posts.text: Nvidia’s $235 Billion Buyback, SpaceX Milestone and Meta’s AI Push. Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down Nvidia's decision to boost the size of its share buyback plan by a record $150 billion, taking the total amount to $235 billion. Plus, SpaceX's Starship rocket reaches orbit for the first time, marking a major milestone after an engine failed during ascent and briefly put the mission at risk. And, Meta taps MongoDB's president and CEO to lead a new AI platform for enterprise customers that Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg called “the next major pillar of our business.” (Source: Bloomberg)

posts.author: Bloomberg Tech
posts.text: Trump, Anthropic CEO Take AI Safety Debate to Dinner. President Donald Trump and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei met for dinner as their opposing views on AI safety increasingly shape the debate over how quickly the technology should advance. Amodei has called for “pacing” development of the most advanced models and stronger guardrails, while President Trump has pushed back against slowing AI development as the US races to stay ahead of China. Bloomberg’s Mike Shepard discusses what’s known about the meeting with Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

posts.author: Bloomberg Tech
posts.text: Gecko CEO: Physical AI Needs Humans in Control. Gecko Robotics CEO Jake Loosararian says the next phase of AI safety is about keeping humans in control as autonomous systems move into the physical world. He discusses Gecko’s work with Nvidia on an open agent safety platform designed to set boundaries around AI agents operating robots, including in military and industrial settings. Loosararian argues that safety and rapid deployment don’t have to be at odds. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

posts.text: AMD Acquires Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 Billion. AMD is acquiring World Labs, an AI startup founded by industry pioneer and researcher Fei-Fei Li, in an all-stock transaction valuing World Labs at about $8.2 billion. AMD CEO Lisa Su and World Labs co-founder and CEO Fei-Fei Li sit down with Bloomberg Tech's Ed Ludlow to discuss why AMD is purchasing World Labs, the two companies' shared vision for AI's future encompassing all layers of the stack, and how the industry needs to come together for shared responsibility in developing a safe technology that benefits all of society. (Source: Bloomberg)

posts.text: Rockefeller’s Ruchir Sharma Warns AI Bubble To Burst After 10-Year Yield Hits 5%. Ruchir Sharma, Chairman at Rockefeller International and Founder and CIO of Breakout Capital, warns that rising Treasury yields could become a danger zone for the AI trade. Sharma’s recent column arguing that a 5% level on the 10-year yield could potentially derail the AI boom, notes that yields are now meaningfully above that threshold and asking what 5.2% implies for the sector. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Emily Graffeo on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

posts.text: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 nearly matches Opus 5.5 on benchmarks while costing up to 30 percent less per task. Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5.5, the second model in its Claude 5.5 family. It generates output more than 30 percent faster, costs up to 30 percent less per task, and nearly matches Opus 5.5 on knowledge-work benchmarks. On Terminal-Bench, a coding benchmark, the model jumps from 10.3 to 70.6 percent. With Haiku 5.5 announced for the coming weeks, Anthropic will soon have a direct counterpart to each of OpenAI's three GPT-6 models.
